scope: Standard online undergraduate rates for these three non-nursing B.S. editions. This review adds program bindings; previously reviewed prices and source review dates remain unchanged.

facts: Online undergraduate tuition is $410 per semester credit at 12 or more semester hours and $475 at 11 or fewer.
The listed military, RN/BSN, Online Academy and Wilmington School of the Bible rates are separate from the standard undergraduate rate; none identifies these three degree programs.
The technology fee is $349 per semester and the degree completion application fee is $100 per application.
The $50 application and readmission fees are no longer applied as of mid-September 2026.
The $38-per-hour inclusive access fee is waived for online undergraduate students taking online undergraduate courses.

limitations: Military and other personal eligibility-based rates or fee waivers are not assumed.
Books, supplies, course-specific charges, transcript charges, provider taxes and living costs remain excluded where not priced.
Course pace, subscription months and semester loads are planning assumptions; prices do not establish registration availability or a graduation date.
The degree completion application fee is included once in this scenario; subtract any fee already paid.
